reason: The README describes a DSH interface plugin whose primary purpose is customizing the web GUI background with local Wallpaper Engine or WaifuX media, including selection, rotation, playback, and visual styling controls.

summaries.zh: 将 Wallpaper Engine 或 WaifuX 中的壁纸显示为 DSH Web 界面背景，并提供选择、轮播、播放和模糊亮度等视觉调节功能。
summaries.en: Displays Wallpaper Engine or WaifuX wallpapers behind the DSH web interface with selection, rotation, playback, and visual adjustment controls.

capabilities: Discovers local wallpaper files from configured Wallpaper Engine or WaifuX directories
Serves enumerated local wallpaper media and previews through local HTTP routes
Renders video, image, or web wallpapers behind the DSH web interface
Provides wallpaper selection, playback, rotation, and visual adjustment controls
Stores wallpaper selections and carousel settings in browser localStorage
